nav.official_header: Government of Jharkhand — Higher & Technical Education Department

landing.dept_badge: Department of Higher & Technical Education — Government of Jharkhand
landing.hero_desc: connects citizen-reported societal issues in Jharkhand to the research capacity of higher education institutions and the execution capital of industry partners, governed by district administration.
landing.role_citizen_desc: Report civic, water, agricultural, or livelihood problems without mandatory login. Voice notes & photos supported.
landing.role_uni_desc: Access matched challenges ranked by Shodhganga expertise tags, form project teams, and submit student-faculty proposals.
landing.role_ind_desc: Match corporate CSR mandates to open proposals, commit mentoring/funding, and execute automated IP agreements.
landing.role_dvo_desc: Review AI-prescreened challenges, inspect field evidence, and enforce the 48-hour validation SLA.
landing.role_govt_desc: Real-time analytics across Jharkhand districts, monitor past-SLA escalations, and execute independent outcome verification.

citizen_hub.title: Citizen Actions & Community Hub
citizen_hub.desc: Empowering citizens, Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs), Self-Help Groups (SHGs), and local communities across Jharkhand to report grassroot challenges, monitor resolution lifecycles, and explore state-verified outcomes.
citizen_hub.submit_desc: Report a civic, water, agricultural, or livelihood problem
citizen_hub.submit_p1: Multimodal reporting: type text, upload photos, or record voice notes
citizen_hub.submit_p3: AI pre-screening automatically indexes and routes the challenge
citizen_hub.submit_p4: No login required for citizens or PRI representatives
citizen_hub.track_desc: Check progress on a challenge you already reported
citizen_hub.track_p1: Search instantly using your unique tracking ID (e.g. SS-1001)
citizen_hub.track_p2: Track 48-hour District STI Nodal Officer validation progress
citizen_hub.track_p3: View matched HEI research teams and student-faculty proposals
citizen_hub.track_p4: Real-time status updates through prototyping and field deployment
citizen_hub.registry_desc: Browse verified outcomes from across Jharkhand
citizen_hub.registry_p1: Explore completed technology deployments across all 24 districts
citizen_hub.registry_p2: Filter by domain sectors: water, agriculture, healthcare, and energy
citizen_hub.registry_p3: Inspect patent filings, publications, and field trial reports
citizen_hub.registry_p4: View active CSR corporate sponsors (Tata Steel, Coal India, etc.)

submit.title: Submit a Grassroots Challenge
submit.subtitle: Directly report community problems in Jharkhand. No login required. Multimodal submissions (photos, voice notes) are supported.
submit.placeholder_title: e.g., Severe Fluoride Contamination in Handpumps (Daltonganj)
submit.placeholder_description: Describe the problem, community impact, location landmarks, and how long this issue has persisted...
submit.label_contact: Submitter Contact (Optional - For tracking SMS/WhatsApp notifications)
submit.placeholder_credit: e.g., Anita Devi & Gram Sabha, or leave empty for Anonymous Citizen
submit.btn_submit: Submit Challenge to District Nodal Officer
submit.success_note: Keep this ID safe to track field validation, academic research matching, and CSR co-investment progress.

track.title: Public Challenge Status Tracker
track.subtitle: Real-time public transparency for citizen submissions. Monitor district validation, academic research matching, CSR funding, and field deployment milestones.
track.confirm_prompt: Is this deployed solution working effectively in your community?
track.confirm_comment_placeholder: Share details on ground performance, water quality, reliability, or maintenance...
track.confirm_success_working: Thank you! Your confirmation that this solution is working has been certified on the Public Registry.
track.confirm_success_disputed: Your dispute feedback has been recorded. This deployment has been flagged for re-review by District & State administration.
track.related_outcome_notice: This report concerns an issue with a previously deployed solution:

registry.title: Public Innovation Outcome Registry
registry.subtitle: Independently verified engineering prototypes, community deployments, and patents generated through ShodhSetu collaborations in Jharkhand.
registry.no_outcomes_sub: Try adjusting your district or sector filters.
registry.btn_report_issue: Report an issue with this deployed solution
registry.report_modal_desc: If a previously verified deployment has malfunctioned, degraded, or ceased working, report it directly here to route back into the validation queue.
registry.issue_title_placeholder: e.g. Solar pump inverter burnt out / Water filter membranes clogged
registry.issue_desc_placeholder: Describe what stopped working, when the failure began, and how the community is currently affected...
registry.issue_success_desc: Your report has been linked to the original solution and dispatched to the district STI nodal officer with elevated priority.
